maya: Quick FYI — I ran a small multi-region + multi-kernel sweep comparing Llama / Mistral / Qwen focused on ROPE handling, GQA accuracy, and context-length scaling. Results attached (short summary below). :chart_with_upwards_trend:

noah: Nice. Which regions / GPUs did you use?

maya: NYC (gcp-us-east4) A100, SFO (gcp-us-west1) H100. Models: llama-2-70b, mistral-7b-instruct, qwen-70b. Contexts: 2048, 8192, 16384. Quant: fp16 baseline + 4-bit quant on dedicated kernels.

li: Can you paste the raw numbers? latency p50/p95 and throughput?

maya: Short excerpt — p50 latency (ms) for 8192 context, single-threaded inference: 
```
model    | A100 p50 | A100 p95 | H100 p50 | H100 p95 | qps (A100)
llama-70 | 220      | 410      | 210      | 380      | 4.1
mistral7 | 48       | 92       | 44       | 85       | 18.5
qwen-70  | 260      | 920*     | 240      | 850*     | 3.6
```
* = observed periodic spikes on H100 beyond 8k tokens that correlate with kernel fallback.

olivia: Whoa the qwen p95 numbers are wild. Any stack traces?

li: I hit a kernel assert when running qwen on H100 with our current rope kernel (v1). Paste log: 
```
[2026-06-02T15:34:12Z] kernel_rope_v1.cu: assert(seq_pos <= max_rope_pos) failed
stack: kernel_launch -> rope_apply -> kv_cache_write
```
It then falls back to a generic slower kernel, hence spikes.

evals-bot: GQA evals: qwen-70b fp16 baseline GQA = 86.3%, qwen-70b 4-bit quant (current runtime) = 85.6% (delta -0.7%). Llama-70b 4-bit = 84.9% (we used same eval harness).

maya: Note: Mistral is clean across kernels (small model, no ROPE issues). Llama and Qwen differ in how they encode long-position rotations which exposes a mismatch in our rope_v1 assumptions.

noah: Any workaround? patch or kernel flag?

olivia: I pushed a tentative patch to a local branch that adds `--rope-mode=legacy|rotary|scaled` toggle and a safe-path for indices > 8192 to use a tiled rope kernel. Patch: https://stash/repo/rope-kernel/branch/rope-safe-tile (WIP).

maya: Re-ran qwen on H100 with `--rope-mode=scaled --force-tile` and spikes vanished: p95 dropped from ~850ms to ~420ms (closer to A100 numbers). Throughput improved ~2x.

li: Great. Can we add a small check in the model onboarding flow to detect ROPE index semantics mismatch? E.g., synthetic input that stresses >8k positions and validates kv-cache continuity.

olivia: Yes — I can add a unit test to the kernel suite and an onboarding probe that runs a 16k prefix roundtrip. If mismatch, we auto-assign `rope-mode=scaled` or fallback to the safe tiled kernel and annotate the model profile.

noah: For capacity planning: given the improved kernel, what's our recommended instance sizing for qwen-70b at 8k and 16k contexts?

maya: Rough guidance after fixes: qwen-70b @8192 on H100: reserve 1x H100 per 12 concurrent single-request streams (90th p95 < 500ms). At 16384 context, reserve 1x H100 per ~6 streams (p95 ~700-900ms depending on batching). We'll add concrete CSV to the run artifacts.

deploy-bot: Canary note — deploying `rope-mode=scaled` for qwen-70b to dedicated-us-west1 tomorrow 06/03 02:00 UTC. Will monitor token latency and error rates.

maya: Action items:
- olivia: add onboarding probe + unit test (ETA EOD)
- li: re-run quant 4-bit sweep with patched kernel and share GQA numbers (ETA tomorrow)
- noah: update capacity calc doc with revised per-GPU stream numbers (ETA this week)
- maya: upload full CSV + flamegraph screenshots to the thread (done)

noah: Thanks — please drop the artifact links here when ready. :thumbsup:
